entry.title: How Lila Sciences’ AI and Automated Labs Help Scientists Discover New Medicines Faster

media:group.media:title: How Lila Sciences’ AI and Automated Labs Help Scientists Discover New Medicines Faster
media:group.media:description:
Lila Sciences connects AI agents to an autonomous lab to explore a therapy designed to help a patient’s own immune cells fight B-cell lymphoma. Lila builds an experimental plan using NVIDIA Nemotron and NVIDIA Agent Toolkit, while models built with NVIDIA BioNeMo can run millions of virtual experiments to identify promising candidates for lab testing. In Lila’s AI Science Factory, robotic instruments make and test those candidates. The results return to inform the next round of designs and experiments.

entry.title: From Prompt to Walking Robot With NVIDIA RTX Spark

media:group.media:title: From Prompt to Walking Robot With NVIDIA RTX Spark
media:group.media:description:
AI agents on NVIDIA RTX Spark help developers turn ideas into real-world robots. Astra connects FreeCAD, Blender, and SimReady Foundation to create assets and build training environments in NVIDIA Isaac Sim.
NVIDIA Omniverse RTX and Newton bring perception and physics together, while reinforcement learning in NVIDIA Isaac Lab trains Micro Duck to navigate obstacles. After training in the cloud, its policy is validated in Isaac Sim on RTX Spark, bringing its learned skills from simulation into the real world.

entry.title: Introducing NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture for Safer AI Agents

media:group.media:title: Introducing NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture for Safer AI Agents
media:group.media:description:
Introducing NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture, an open hardware and software architecture for securing autonomous AI agents across the full stack. As agents take on long-running workflows at scale, safety requires controls outside the agents themselves. See why model alignment alone is not enough—and how models, tools, harnesses, and runtimes fit together.
Without proper governance, agents can expose sensitive information, access unauthorized systems, or attempt to change their own permissions to complete a task. With models running on GPUs and harnesses and tools on CPUs, securing agents requires a systems approach.
📖 Read the press release → https://nvda.ws/4jzEjGv
#NVIDIAGTC #AgenticAI #AISecurity #AISafety

entry.title: AI Factories That Use Less Power and Water, Built in Days | NVIDIA DSX

media:group.media:title: AI Factories That Use Less Power and Water, Built in Days | NVIDIA DSX
media:group.media:description:
Efficient infrastructure is the foundation for scaling AI. NVIDIA DSX is a full-stack AI factory reference architecture, co-designed across compute, networking, storage, power, and cooling. Validated in a digital twin before construction begins.
DSX Max LPS uses 30% less power for the same output. Closed-loop liquid cooling and outdoor dry coolers save up to 54 million liters of water per day, the equivalent of 180,000 households. And with NVIDIA DSX POD providing fully cabled, factory-tested NVIDIA Vera Rubin infrastructure in containers, on-site deployment goes from months to days.
Faster to build. Responsible by design.
